summary: Complete Russian translation for all Hearth 2.2.0 menus, help texts, update prompts, and remote actions.
Fix self-updater to track emoorpheus/HearthNG releases instead of upstream tld.my.customlauncher.
Harden bundled key hook (homehook.sh) to check live /proc maps so restarted input daemons are re-hooked.
Integrate upstream Hearth 2.2.0: editable Essentials tab, Settings help and live previews, Most used order, network folder, and more.
Fix app kickout after TV turn-on and long standby by preserving user apps over transient services (helper 18-ng8).
Keep all saved HearthNG settings, OLED Pure Black theme, HDMI signal dots, and TileEdit.
Prevent false collision relaunches and preserve the cold-start app-opening guard during TV boot.
Recognize webOS Screen Saver as an active power state and increase empty-foreground debounce (helper 18-ng6).
Initial HearthNG release (com.hearthng.launcher) based on Hearth 2.1.3.
Includes Russian translation, OLED Pure Black preset, HDMI live signal indicator, LG-style tile editing, and Screen Saver toggle.
